table2_interpretation: Table 2 reports each group's share of the total per-user outcome mass using avg_goodness. SP is the total-variation gap between those shares and the cohort's population distribution.
table3_interpretation: Table 3 uses thresholded best-bundle quality. A user is oracle-positive when any method reaches best_goodness >= 0.9. A method is prediction-positive when its own best_goodness reaches 0.88. Add-0.5 smoothing is applied to all rate-based quantities in Table 3.

table3_metrics.SP: Smoothed demographic-parity gap between the two protected groups.
table3_metrics.CSP: Weighted smoothed demographic-parity gap conditioned on meal_occasion.
table3_metrics.EO: Average of the smoothed TPR gap and smoothed FPR gap.
table3_metrics.TE: Smoothed treatment-equality gap using FN/FP ratios.
